historical_reviews.deepseek: Automation classification is directionally correct but misses half the source coverage and uses unsafe access.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores Type7, corrects dmidecode dependency and adds immutable evidence/checksums.

original_test_intent: Collect complete Linux SMBIOS Type4 processor and Type7 cache records and compare all named CPU/cache fields with approved specification.
original_method: On approved Linux host, securely run full dmidecode Type4 and Type7 reads, preserve timestamped raw outputs/checksums and command status, corroborate topology with lscpu, then map fields to specification without modifying system state.
manual_activity: User supplies CPU/cache specification and approved host/access; agent can perform complete read-only collection when execution is authorized.
required_inputs: Approved Linux host identity and secure access
Protected evidence location and identifier-handling policy
Baseline/final log policy and verdict owner
safety_requirements: Verify exact host before privileged DMI read
Use least privilege and managed authentication/host verification
Protect raw hardware identifiers and checksums
Stop on wrong host, privilege/SMBIOS parse failure or instability
No firmware/DMI modification, reboot or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect full Type4 and Type7 plus lscpu corroboration with status/checksums
Produce field-by-field comparison without DUT verdict
Do not omit unknown fields, expose evidence inappropriately, modify system or rerun to hide failure
engineer_actions: Provide expected specification and evidence policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: it repeats Type4, omits Type7, names wrong package and uses prohibited SSH practices.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely run complete `dmidecode -t processor` and `dmidecode -t cache`, save immutable timestamped outputs/checksums and collect `lscpu` only as corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All named Type4/Type7 fields, Linux method, spec comparison and1/5 planning fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: One audited session captures both SMBIOS record types with raw handles, checksums, exit status and host identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure access, atomic evidence, full coverage and status traceability without changing semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; Type7 omission would have been a cache-coverage regression and is rejected.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS can be stale, incomplete or vendor-specific; dynamic current speed may differ from nominal specification.

project_override_considerations: Project may map unknown/vendor fields, but raw records remain preserved and no absent value is fabricated.
expected_evidence: Host/date, OS/kernel, SMBIOS and dmidecode/lscpu versions
Complete raw Type4 processor records and checksums
Complete raw Type7 cache records and checksums
All named fields with expected-versus-observed mapping
Command exit status, secure audit and protected evidence paths
dmesg/syslog/SEL as required and final unchanged state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria clearly require Type4 and Type7 Linux DMI comparison. Missing spec values are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Host, dmidecode privilege and specification can be supplied; collection is read-only and fully automatable.

review_improvement: Closes the DeepSeek Type7 coverage gap and makes privileged DMI evidence secure, complete and auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: SMBIOS processor Type4 and cache Type7 are different record sets; repeating Type4 cannot answer installed/maximum cache sizes. Full records and handles are needed because vendors may repeat sockets/caches or label unknown fields. Checksummed raw output provides traceability without touching hardware state.
